brand.name: Underworld Writer
brand.tagline: Build the world. Track the truth. Ship the story.
brand.supportingLine: Character systems · Narrative engine · Editorial control

canonicalCover.usage: authoritative visual source for product releases, release notes, social release cards, repository launch graphics, and package announcements

typography.display: bold geometric sans-serif, uppercase where used by the cover
rules: Do not redraw or substitute the UNDERWORLD WRITER wordmark when the canonical cover is available.
Version badges and release annotations must use a neutral sans-serif and remain visually subordinate to the cover wordmark.
Do not use decorative fantasy fonts over the canonical artwork.

protectedRegions: left title and supporting copy block
right-side magenta light column and cavern focal point

releaseBadge.preferredPosition: bottom-left safe margin below the existing supporting copy, or top-right only when it does not cover the cavern focal point

rules: Prefer the approved cover unchanged for wide release headers.
Never recolor the mascot or wordmark.
Never place release text over the UNDERWORLD WRITER wordmark.
For aspect ratios narrower than the source, extend the background or letterbox before cropping protected regions.
Use palette colors from this contract for any added panels, badges, rules, or text.

githubSocial.strategy: contain canonical cover over an extended/blurred void-purple background; do not crop protected regions

openGraph.strategy: contain canonical cover over an extended/blurred void-purple background; add version badge only in a safe margin

square.strategy: use a branded frame with the canonical cover inset; do not crop title or mascot

requirements: Read this file before generating any release artwork.
Use the canonical cover as the visual anchor rather than inventing a new theme.
Include release version and up to four highlights only when needed.
Preserve the brand hierarchy: Fused Gaming / Open Source → Underworld Writer → supporting line → release annotation.
Generated release art is derivative output and must not replace the canonical source cover.
